definitions.short: Zebadjah , the name of nine Israelites
definitions.full: H2069. Zebadyah or Zebadyahu זְבַדְיָה זְבַדְיָהוּ, proper name, masculine ( ׳י hath bestowed , compare יְהוֺזָבָד , & references, also זַבְדִּיאֵל above) — זְבַדְיָהוּ 1 Levites , a. 1Chr 26:2 ; b. 2Chr 17:8 . 2 an officer of Jehoshaphat 2Chr 19:11 . זְבַדְיָה 3 Benjamites , a. 1Chr 8:15 ; b. 1Chr 8:17 . 4 one of David's men 1Chr 12:8 . 5 an officer of David 1Chr 27:7 . 6 a returning exile Ezra 8:8 . 7 one of priestly house Ezra 10:20 .
definitions.rootNote: or זְבַדְיָהוּ ; from 2064 and 3050 ; Jah has given;
